pages.title: European Wild Ass
pages.text: The European wild ass ($(o)Equus hydruntinus$()) is an extinct equid that lived across Europe, western Asia and the Middle East during the Middle and Late Pleistocene, surviving into the Holocene.$(br2)It was a small, slender animal adapted to open, dry steppes.$(br2)Ancient DNA shows it was closely related to the Asiatic wild ass, and it disappeared only a few thousand years ago, after people had begun farming in its range.
